name: IDP Education Limited
summary: IDP Education Limited provides student placement services in Asia, Australasia, and internationally. The company is involved in the placement of international students into education institutions; and provides services, such as digital marketing, events, consultancy and data services, and peer to peer software. It also distributes and administrates International English Language Testing System (IELTS) tests for study, work, and migration purposes. In addition, the company operates English language schools.
